x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

BodyParticipation.title: BodyParticipation
BodyParticipation.description: A participation edge (W3C org ontology / Popolo org:Membership with an organisation as member) recording that a participating GovernanceBody (a municipal council/organisation) participates in a shared GovernanceBody (a gemeenschappelijke regeling / joint body per Wgr). Carries per-edge master data: seats, org-level votingWeight agreed in the regeling, and toetreding/uittreding dates, and history (a withdrawn participant stays visible as a record). A participation is ACTIVE when uittredingsDatum is null or lies in the future (the Membership active-window semantics); this active-window predicate is a read-side evaluation, not a lifecycle state, so this schema declares no x-openregister-lifecycle. votingWeight is org-level master data surfaced as the suggested default when creating a Membership in the shared body and is NEVER read by any vote-computation path: weighted voting reuses the existing Membership votingWeight machinery per meeting-attendees.

sharedBody.title: Shared body
sharedBody.description: Required reference to the shared GovernanceBody (the gemeenschappelijke regeling / joint body). Many-to-one (see x-openregister-relations).

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: Required reference to the participating GovernanceBody (the council/organisation). Many-to-one (see x-openregister-relations).

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Number of seats the participant holds in the shared body.

votingWeight.title: Voting weight
votingWeight.description: Org-level vote weight agreed in the regeling (master data). Surfaced as the suggested default when creating a Membership in the shared body; NEVER read by any vote-computation path.

accessionDate.title: Accession date
accessionDate.description: Date-time of accession (toetreding) to the shared body.

exitDate.title: Withdrawal date
exitDate.description: Date-time of withdrawal (uittreding). Null while participating; a participation is active when this is null or in the future (active-window).

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label for the participation, e.g. 'Deelnemer per oprichting'.

Zienswijzeronde.title: Zienswijzeronde
Zienswijzeronde.description: A zienswijzeprocedure round (schema:Action) opened by a shared GovernanceBody on a document or decision (e.g. de ontwerpbegroting, Wgr art. 35): what the body asks, on what subject, by when. Opening the ronde fans out to one Zienswijze per active BodyParticipation (imperative ZienswijzerondeService:openRonde, D6, no dialect creates objects). The subject document(s) attach via OpenRegister's Files leaf (no app-local file storage). The status workflow is declared EXCLUSIVELY via the canonical x-openregister-lifecycle dialect (ADR-031, keyword 'initial'); Decidiq implements no imperative state machine for it. cyclusStap is a nullable soft reference to the pc-cyclus sibling's cyclus-stap (the GR ontwerpbegroting is a P&C artifact): the ronde works standalone and either change lands first. decision links the shared body's vaststellingsbesluit after processing (universal Decision model; this capability creates no meetings, agenda items, or decisions).

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-SGB-004). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). concept -> geopend -> verwerking -> afgerond, plus concept -> ingetrokken and geopend -> ingetrokken; afgerond and ingetrokken terminal. The concept -> geopend transition is the fan-out point (ZienswijzerondeService::openRonde generates the per-participant zienswijzen). Transitions outside this map are rejected by OpenRegister; no app-side state machine.

sharedBody.title: Shared body
sharedBody.description: Required reference to the shared GovernanceBody opening the ronde. Many-to-one (see x-openregister-relations).

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: The kind of subject the ronde concerns. Required.

subjectDescription.title: Subject description
subjectDescription.description: Optional free-text description of the subject.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Date by which participating organisations must submit their zienswijze (Wgr art. 35). Required. Copied onto each generated Zienswijze at opening so the declarative rappels filter on the zienswijze's own field (D5).

cyclusStep.title: P&C step
cyclusStep.description: Optional nullable soft reference to the pc-cyclus sibling's cyclus-stap (the GR ontwerpbegroting is a P&C artifact). The ronde works standalone; either change lands first.

decision.title: Vaststellingsbesluit
decision.description: Optional reference to the shared body's closing vaststellingsbesluit (e.g. vaststelling van de begroting) linked before transitioning verwerking -> afgerond.

status.title: Status
status.description: Ronde lifecycle status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): concept -> geopend -> verwerking -> afgerond, plus concept/geopend -> ingetrokken. afgerond and ingetrokken are terminal.

Zienswijze.title: Zienswijze
Zienswijze.description: A single participating organisation's zienswijze (schema:Action) within a Zienswijzeronde: its deadline tracking, standpunt, response document (Files leaf), and how the shared body processed it (verwerking). One Zienswijze is generated per active BodyParticipation when the ronde transitions concept -> geopend (ZienswijzerondeService:openRonde, idempotent per ronde+participant, D6). deadline is denormalised from the ronde at generation so the declarative rappels (x-openregister-notifications, filtering non-terminal status + deadline window) fire per zienswijze to reach the right organisation (D5). decision links the participant council's raadsbesluit adopting the zienswijze; the zienswijze itself creates no meetings, agenda items, or decisions (pc-cyclus linkage discipline). The status workflow is declared EXCLUSIVELY via the canonical x-openregister-lifecycle dialect (ADR-031); rappels EXCLUSIVELY via x-openregister-notifications (ADR-031, toezeggingen-register pattern): no imperative dispatch, no bespoke reminder BackgroundJob.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-SGB-005). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). uitstaand -> in-voorbereiding -> ingediend -> verwerkt, plus uitstaand/in-voorbereiding -> niet-ingediend (deadline lapsed without submission); verwerkt and niet-ingediend terminal. Transitions outside this map are rejected by OpenRegister; no app-side state machine.

zienswijzeUitstaand._note: REQ-SGB-009 (3): 'zienswijze uitstaand' — a created trigger notifying the receiving organisation's readers when the zienswijze is generated. Canonical x-openregister-notifications dialect (ADR-031). Recipients approximate the receiving organisation's readers via object-acl (read) + decidesk-members group, because no recipient kind targets the participant GovernanceBody reference directly. Decidiq dispatches no notification imperatively.

zienswijzeRappelBeforeDeadline._note: REQ-SGB-009 (1): pre-deadline rappel. intervalSec 1209600 (~14 days) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — griffie-configurable tuning deferred, the toezeggingen values). Filter targets non-terminal status only so no rappel fires for ingediend/verwerkt/niet-ingediend; the 'deadline within window' vs 'deadline past' distinction is carried by the scheduled engine's window semantics — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as before/after-deadline rappels during live import (same caveat as the toezeggingen-register precedent).

zienswijzeRappelOverdue._note: REQ-SGB-009 (2): overdue rappel. intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal status so no rappel fires for a terminal zienswijze. Same window-semantics caveat as zienswijzeRappelBeforeDeadline.

ronde.title: Ronde
ronde.description: Required reference to the Zienswijzeronde this zienswijze belongs to. Many-to-one (see x-openregister-relations).

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: Required reference to the GovernanceBody whose zienswijze this is. Many-to-one (see x-openregister-relations).

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Deadline copied from the ronde at generation (D5) so the declarative scheduled rappels filter on the object's own field.

position.title: Standpunt
position.description: The participant's position on the subject. Optional until recorded.

submittedDate.title: Submission date
submittedDate.description: Date-time on which the participant submitted its zienswijze.

decision.title: Raadsbesluit
decision.description: Optional reference to the participant council's besluit adopting the zienswijze (the raadsbesluit).

processing.title: Verwerking
processing.description: How the shared body processed this zienswijze. Set by the shared body during verwerking.

processingNotes.title: Verwerking note
processingNotes.description: Explanation of how the zienswijze was processed (recorded with verwerking).

status.title: Status
status.description: Zienswijze lifecycle status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): uitstaand -> in-voorbereiding -> ingediend -> verwerkt, plus uitstaand/in-voorbereiding -> niet-ingediend. verwerkt and niet-ingediend are terminal.

Membership.description: Additive delta (ADR-037 fragment-located additive pattern, mirroring fragment 55's Decision delta): this fragment merges ONLY the optional namens property onto the existing membership schema (deep-merge unions it with the base Membership's existing properties). No required field is added and no existing property, enum value, or required-field set is modified, so memberships created before this change stay valid.

onBehalfOf.title: Namens
onBehalfOf.description: Optional reference (Popolo on_behalf_of, parallel to the existing party property) to the participating GovernanceBody the member sits namens in a shared body. Absent for every non-shared body; filterable/groupable in the shared body's roster via standard relation queries. Many-to-one.
